purpose: Bounded audit of public deal-lead attribution for investor/company pairs already present in real Funding Radar reports.

evidence.title: Announcing our Series A and Seed | Parahelp
evidence.quote: $3.2M Seed round led by Blake Robbins at Hidden Capital and an $18M Series A round led by Jack Altman at Alt Capital.

evidence.title: Inkeep raises $13M so every team can ship AI Agents they trust
evidence.note: The primary announcement names investor firms but no individual deal lead.

evidence.title: Team - Base10
evidence.note: Fetched public page rendered generic team text and no company-specific person attribution.

pairs.caveat: Use the Seed attribution. The same announcement also describes a separately led Series A.
Current portfolio owner is explicit. This source does not identify the leader of the January 27, 2026 financing specifically.
Portfolio page lists investment year 2025. Do not label this as confirmed leadership of the January 27, 2026 financing.
Generic Khosla partner biographies are insufficient to assign a person to this deal.
A publicly quoted partner is not automatically a deal lead. No explicit primary company-specific attribution was located within the bounded search.

supplementaryFact.caveat: Supplementary source fact; do not add an investor to a recommendation without the normal financing/fit checks.

generalizablePatterns: Select an actual financing sentence, then match '<stage> round led by <Person> at/of/from <Investor>' with entity boundaries and person-name validation.
For investor-owned company portfolio pages, require a company-specific title/name and an explicit Investment Lead or Deal Lead heading immediately followed by a linked person.
Portfolio ownership remains scope company unless the source explicitly identifies the evaluated financing round.
Quoted partners, board membership, generic team pages and authorship alone do not establish a deal lead.
